title: Microsoft 365 admin center: agent-level controls for pay-as-you-go
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, billing qualifications and documented controls are supported. The agent-blocking route should include Microsoft's fuller navigation, and the checklist contains group-management and Azure-role checks without corresponding controls-table rows.

claims.claim: The item concerns agent-level pay-as-you-go controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The planned controls let administrators choose which agents are available for metered consumption.

claims.claim: Every checklist control-management instruction has a matching controls-table row.
